p4_card.identity: Pro-myelinating agents (muscarinic-antagonist class such as clemastine and benztropine, thyroid-hormone and antipsychotic routes) and, as a separate question, activity manipulation as a myelin lever. [ADV-001] For clemastine and benztropine two routes are documented (M1 genetics in culture; EBP inhibition with zymostenol accumulation in mouse OPC sterol profiling) and their attribution is unsettled; tamoxifen has documented EBP inhibition and quetiapine one main-text report of it; EBP is unmeasured for the other antimuscarinics named. A profile of the pathway intermediates per compound before target attribution is a design position (INFERENZA), not a result. This does not say that EBP explains the muscarinic route, that unmeasured compounds act through EBP, or that M1 is irrelevant (ebp_reannotation_adv001_20261113).
p4_card.indication_and_transfer: Only IF the Wwox-deficient oligodendrocyte lineage is itself the limiting compartment, which the neuron-versus-oligodendrocyte genetic arms argue against. Transfer unmeasured.
p4_card.novelty_for_woree: N-13 stands. New: the earlier record (DL-MECH-031 point 2) proposed that reducing seizure load might itself improve myelination because myelination is activity-dependent. The best-matched non-WWOX datum points the other way for a seizing network: Knowles 2022, Nat Neurosci (PMID 35501379, abstract read; absence-seizure models, not WWOX) reports that seizure-driven activity increases oligodendrogenesis and myelination in the seizure network, is prevented by seizure suppression, and that blocking activity-dependent myelination lowers seizure burden. The Wwox-null brain is hypomyelinated despite bursting, so neither simple sign is established. Also found: the 'near-complete MBP rescue' of the neuronal AAV is image-only (DA-W2-011).
p4_card.pathway_and_objective: BENEFICIO_PRECOCE if ever; broad recovery needs the developmental endpoint.
p4_card.mechanism: Target (if pursued): oligodendrocyte differentiation or the axon-oligodendrocyte activity signal. Direction wanted: more compact myelin. The causal compartment is neuronal, so a drug acting on oligodendrocytes alone is not expected to reach the cause.

external_not_wwox_evidence: Saab 2016 Neuron (PMID 27292539), title only: oligodendroglial NMDA receptors and axonal energy metabolism

for: Myelin is reduced in the knockout and activity-dependent myelination exists in other systems.
against: Oligodendrocyte-lineage deletion shows no anomaly while neuronal deletion reproduces it.
The oligodendrocyte-promoter AAV arm gave no detectable protein, so it neither supports nor refutes oligodendroglial relevance.
In a seizure network, activity drives maladaptive myelination in the other-disease precedent: suppressing activity may lower or raise myelin depending on the system; the sign here is unmeasured.
Oligodendroglial NMDA receptors support axonal energy metabolism in the other-disease precedent, so chronic NMDAR block (F01) has a myelin-side cost that is unmeasured.
evidence_for_and_against.transfer_limits: Absence-seizure and healthy-brain systems; adult versus neonatal; no Wwox arm.

p4_card.pharmacology: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE, class level, no dose, no score, no compound carded [IT59 2026-11-20 unit B packet change]. CLEMASTINE (public-database rows of HE ADV-098 batch 6 and SCI's verified reading of primary papers): strong histamine H1 and muscarinic binding; within one document muscarinic M1 is the most potent of five subtypes with a six-fold range, an indication of M1 preference and not an identified selectivity; a second, undated panel measures M4, M5 and M3 (Ki about 3 to 8 nanomolar) and carries M1 and M2 rows without a value, so the M1 indication rests on the one 2020 document, where M5 is within 1.4-fold of M1; no measured myelination or oligodendrocyte-precursor differentiation row exists in the held IC50, Ki, Kd and EC50 rows (the link from M1 antagonism to differentiation is mechanism from the literature). Exposure: a total plasma Cmax of 44.0 ng/mL in the neonatal mouse at steady state of one daily oral regimen, dosed on the fumarate salt basis, that was not the lowest dose tested (Odell 2024, read at source by a blind verifier); no unbound and no brain value in that paper; juvenile rat brain detection is qualitative only (one paper, inconsistent about the age). Harm: in the healthy developing mouse, at the single higher dose described, slower conduction with fewer nodes, more differentiated cells and thinner myelin in thin axons (one dose only, so no margin can be read). Label (US label record, public database): clemastine fumarate syrup for allergic rhinitis, paediatric use confirmed from 6 to 12 years for that indication (labels in other countries differ). THYROMIMETICS: thyroid-hormone-receptor beta preference depends on the readout (sobetirome: seven of eight same-document pairs beta-preferring by 3.4- to 26-fold, one reversed; tiratricol: beta-preferring by about three-fold in binding and alpha-preferring in one reporter assay); the natural hormone's ratio of the alpha value to the beta value is 0.5 to 1.0 in the seven of sobetirome's eight same-document pairs that carry it (one has none), that is equal on both receptors or up to about two-fold more potent on alpha; no measured myelination row in those rows; papers exist on brain delivery of sobetirome prodrugs after systemic dosing in mice (the abstract gives no age) and on tiratricol brain content after intracerebroventricular delivery in Mct8-deficient mice (titles and abstracts read, numbers not read; a different disease context); a late start gave no myelination gain in one small mouse study of thyroid-hormone transporter deficiency, so the window may matter; label: tiratricol is authorised for peripheral thyrotoxicosis in MCT8 deficiency (a different disorder; nothing about myelination); none found for sobetirome. Added class-level facts, no compound carded, no dose, no score, NOT WWOX EVIDENCE [IT59 2026-11-20 third packet change] (HE ADV-098 batch 7, database rows and label records): four agents with four different mechanisms, so no potency comparison across them. None of the four has a database row that measures an oligodendrocyte-differentiation or myelination effect: the potency rows are the primary-target rows and are not the myelination mechanism (the link is literature; for the agents whose literature the sheet lists it was read at title level only). BENZTROPINE: muscarinic M1 Ki of 0.59 and 0.95 nanomolar at rat M1 (the 0.59 rows from rat brain membranes; the 0.95 row names no tissue) and 0.13 nanomolar in a human panel (up to about seven-fold between sources); pharmacokinetic and brain-distribution hits found by title for benztropine analogs only, none for benztropine itself by these routes; label: caution in paediatric patients over three years. MICONAZOLE: a human CYP51 IC50 of 200 nanomolar (lanosterol demethylase assay on enzyme expressed in a cell system, 2007) is among the rows; other human cytochromes (CYP3A4, CYP2C19) are inhibited at lower concentrations in several rows; the largest named human target groups are other cytochromes and a transporter; no row measures sterol intermediates or oligodendrocyte differentiation, so the proposed route from sterol-enzyme inhibition to differentiation is not tested in these rows; no rodent brain or plasma concentration found by the routes read; the label is a topical over-the-counter antifungal, which says nothing about CNS exposure. CLOBETASOL PROPIONATE (read separately from the parent record): glucocorticoid receptor IC50 3.17 nanomolar in rat liver cytosol against IC50 1.46 (Ki 0.66) nanomolar in a human panel (about two-fold on IC50; different species and sources); no rodent brain concentration of the plain compound found (central delivery is said to be a formulation problem by one paper read at title level only); label: topical, not recommended under 12 years. BEXAROTENE: within one 1997 document (human receptors) the RXR-beta, RXR-gamma and RXR-alpha Ki values (5.9, 8.3 and 16 nanomolar) against RAR-alpha, RAR-beta and RAR-gamma Ki values of 180, 50 and 130 nanomolar give an in vitro RXR preference of about three- to thirty-fold (about three- to eight-fold against RAR-beta), a comparable contrast within that document and not an in vivo selectivity; in the other held documents every RAR Ki or Kd is above one micromolar or is a bound (the lowest bound above 550 nanomolar), and one of them reports an RAR-alpha EC50 of 6 nanomolar against a Ki of about 5.5 micromolar, not reconciled; in that same 1999 document this RAR-alpha EC50 is also below its RXR EC50 values (20 to 28 nanomolar), with RAR-beta and RAR-gamma EC50 of 282 and 648 nanomolar, while its binding values favour RXR by about ninety-fold or more; two calorimetry rows elsewhere give an RXR-alpha Kd above one micromolar; other documents give human RXR-alpha EC50 from 2.7 to 149 nanomolar (measured values); a mouse plasma and brain quantification method paper exists (numbers not read); label: cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, paediatric safety and effectiveness not established.

p4_card.predictions: Registered: if hypomyelination is driven by loss of an axonal signal, an oligodendrocyte-directed compound leaves it unchanged in Wwox-deficient neurons and corrects it only after neuronal restoration; if activity raises myelin in this genotype, chronic suppression lowers MBP; if activity suppression helps, MBP rises. The three outcomes are separable by one chronic-suppression arm and one activity-raising arm against vehicle.
p4_card.next_measurement: Wet-lab, not done: Wwox-null (or conditional neuronal) mice or co-cultures; arms: vehicle, chronic activity suppression, activity-raising manipulation, one pro-myelinating agent; controls: wild type with the same arms, neuronal-restoration positive control; endpoints: quantified MBP and g-ratio by electron microscopy, oligodendrocyte counts; discriminating result: the direction of the myelin change under suppression versus under activity.
p4_card.value_added: Records that the seizure-load-improves-myelin inference was an assumption with a counter-precedent, and that the neuronal rescue's myelin evidence is image-level.
p4_card.clinical_census: Clinical census, ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, 2026-10-20 (drug_repurposing/clinical_census_20261020.md): seven queries returned no registered WOREE interventional study; it answers seven queries against one registry on one date and a missing hit does not prove that no study exists. Not re-run for this card.

card_conventions: IPOTESI throughout; the bridge forces it. No score, rank, probability or blended index is carried.
directional_summary compares signs only where target, endpoint and every context dimension match; UNRESOLVED is a statement about the record, not about the biology.
Every disease-side row from the Drosophila article is NOT WWOX-DEE EVIDENCE; the organoid rows are exploratory transcript analyses of one deposit.
Abstract-level statements from PubMed are labelled abstract_only; none carries a receipt.
label_lookup is NOT_ATTEMPTED in the bridge: the bridge has no network. The openFDA adapter was run separately and is recorded in lucas_clarke_followup_20261026/compounds_and_sources.md.
